individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of dissected intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a micrograph of H&E-stained tissue sections, not a plot.

Panel C includes a box plot (exempt, distribution already shown) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per genotype/diameter bin; the bar chart shows only aggregated values with no individual mouse data points overlaid, despite n=8-18 per genotype.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1 and Cdc42 shows only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel F is an immunohistochemistry micrograph, not a plot.
The bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows only mean bars with error bars and significance markers; no individual data points are shown.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A is a photograph with no plotted error bars.
not needed - Panel B is a micrograph with no plotted error bars.

FAIL - Panel C's box plot displays whiskers/box elements, but the caption ('The mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps in ApcMin/+ mice with different Asef and Asef2 genotypes at 4 months of age (n=8-18 per genotype). *P<0.05; ***P<0.001.') does not state what the box, whiskers, or center line represent (e.g., quartiles, min/max, median).
not needed - Kaplan-Meier survival curves do not carry error bars.
FAIL - The bar chart of GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows error bars, but the caption does not specify whether these represent SD, SEM, or another measure, nor the number of replicates.
not needed - Panel F is a micrograph with no plotted error bars.
FAIL - The relative expression bar chart shows error bars and significance asterisks, but the caption does not define what the error bars represent or state the statistical test/replicate number.
